name: watch
description: memory-kit watch: delivers a home's declared inboxes into the session as prompts (idle-safe), and reports, information only, idleness and context growth past the marks the home declares in memory-kit.conf

home.title: Kit home
home.description: The kit home whose memory-kit.conf declares the sources (watch_sources) and the report marks (watch_idle_minutes, watch_context_percent). Empty: the directory the session started in.

pollSeconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the sources are drained and the report checks run. Local file reads only.
